room_rent.note: No room rent limit applicable under Premiere plan.

icu.note: No ICU sub-limit mentioned for Premiere plan.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment stated for Premiere plan.

sub_limits.note: Ambulance 1% of SI max ₹5,000/hosp; Maternity ₹1L/delivery; Home Care ₹5,000/day max 15 days; Specs/lens/hearing aids ₹10,000/yr; High End Diagnostics ₹25,000/yr; Air Ambulance ₹5L/yr; Infertility ₹2L lifetime; Bariatric ₹5L.

maternity.note: Up to ₹1 Lakh/delivery; limited to first 2 deliveries; 36-month waiting period; newborn covered under maternity SI.

cumulative_bonus.note: Maximum cumulative bonus 100% under Premiere plan; health checkup every 2 years irrespective of claim status.

restoration.note: Automatic restoration of Base SI when Base SI and Cumulative Bonus exhausted/insufficient; not applicable for RTA, Home Care, Maternity, Infertility, Bariatric, High End Diagnostics, Global Hospitalisation.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to SI; excludes listed conditions.

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses covered; donor pre/post-hosp not covered.

modern_treatments.note: No explicit exclusion of modern/robotic treatments.

consumables.note: Reimbursement of listed non-medical/consumable items during hospitalisation; subject to admissible inpatient claim.

global_cover.note: Inpatient/Day care expenses outside India up to Base SI; diagnosis must be in India; reimbursement only; no pre/post-hosp; no restoration.

notable_exclusions: Domiciliary excluded for asthma, diabetes, hypertension etc.; alcoholic cirrhosis permanent exclusion; impotency treatment; change-of-gender; adventure sports; global cover requires India diagnosis
optional_riders: Personal Accident cover (up to SI max ₹50L), Medical Second Opinion add-on, Flexi OP Care add-on (OPD cover), Infertility treatment (₹2L lifetime), Bariatric surgery (₹5L)
